summary: authID Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of $1,350,000 aggregate principal senior secured convertible debentures plus 1,800,000 warrants at a $0.50 exercise price to four accredited investors, none affiliated. Debentures sold at par with no original issue discount; warrants cover 4/3 of principal. Closing occurred October 6, 2026, with proceeds for working capital, excluding debt repayment, buybacks, litigation settlement or insider loans. Stockholder approval is required before warrant exercise. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and Nasdaq minimum-price compliance and approval timing.
